name: Taimanin Asagi ~Kessen Arena~
original_name: 対魔忍アサギ～決戦アリーナ～
source:
Battle card game by Lilith which is happening in the Taimaninverse, but outside the main canon timeline of the Visual Novels, where the heir of the Fuuma clan wants to weight into the balance between the three forces (Taimanin, US and Demons) after the collapse of his tribe.

It is a massive crossover with characters from multiple games where most stories are hypothetical "what if" scenarios.
Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena takes place instead of the events of [url=/v10899]Taimanin Asagi 3[/url], in an alternative timeline.
translation:
莉莉丝的战斗卡牌游戏，发生在Taimaninverse，但在视觉小说的主要设定时间线之外，Fuuma氏族的继承人希望在他的部落崩溃后平衡三种力量（Taimanin、美国和恶魔）之间的平衡。

这是来自多个游戏的角色的大规模交叉，其中大多数故事都是假设的“假设”场景。
Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena发生在另一个时间线中，而不是 [url=/v10899]Taimanin Asagi 3[/url] 的事件。
